title: The Quiet Return of Neo-Vintage Case Sizes
excerpt: Why 36–38mm is winning back collectors tired of oversized sports watches.
body:
Case sizes are drifting back toward the proportions that made classic watches feel effortless.
It’s not nostalgia — it’s wearability. Smaller cases often look cleaner, sit better, and make the dial design do more of the talking.

title: Independent Brands to Watch in 2025
excerpt: Five under-the-radar makers delivering serious horology without hype pricing.
body:
The best independent brands are solving the same problem in different ways: honest finishing, strong design language, and value that makes sense.
BEZERU is here for the brands doing real work — not just marketing.

title: How Cartier’s Middle East History Still Shapes Modern Releases
excerpt: From commissions to Arabic dials — the influence never left.
body:
Collectors in the Gulf shaped taste early: precious metals, special dials, and commissions that became reference points.
Today, that influence is visible in modern releases — but it’s often under-explained. That’s what we’ll document.
